[center][size=3]I used the mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43364]Animated Portrait Framework[/url] (APF), to make animated versions of my portrait mod. I created the animations in [url=https://pixai.art]PixAI[/url] and imported them into the framework where I configured everything for this mod. [/size][/center]
[center]
Very much in the earlier steps of this mod- I will be frequently updating this as I make progress on it. [b]So far I've done all of Haley's, Caroline's, Robin's, Sebastian's, and Leah's animations + some of Jodi's.[/b][/center]

[center][size=4][b]Includes beach and seasonal portrait variations + the main vanilla portraits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44050]my portrait mod[/url].[/b][/size][/center]
